evidence: Carries the P2P label, removes legacy connection plumbing from src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp, and creates an isolated network transport engine in src/privbcast/.
rationale: Resolving transaction origin deanonymization is category-critical in P2P. Reviewers note that master's coupled implementation is an 'active footgun that worsens privacy once adversaries correlate recipient slots,' creating severe IP linkage and state-correlation risks across addrman and peer management.
